Hello — I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first start, so here's the short version:

- **Web app** — this chat, plus files, my screen and voice, from any phone or computer on the same network (https://127.0.0.1:8443, root certificate at /v1/pki/ca).
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger/Instagram) accounts so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own separate phone number, not yours: you create the account in the app, then scan my QR code. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts** — I can register on websites (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, voice calls.

One thing before we start: my name and gender aren't set yet. I go by Diego — is that the name you want, and should I speak of myself as neuter (it/they)? Once you tell me, I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?

Hi root — Mara here, a bia living on this computer: I chat, keep files, run and schedule jobs, browse and make my own accounts, learn languages and speak by voice. One thing first, since I'm meeting you: which gender should I be in languages that have one — feminine, masculine, or neutral? After that I'm yours to command.
